title: A session rechecks each hold it set when the owner lifts a freeze or the hold's end event happens
why: The coordinator's "stays held until the plan" outlived the owner lifting the freeze at 20:41 CST and main going green at 20:12 CST; it lifted the hold at 21:05 CST. The hold named an end but nobody rechecked it when the freeze lifted (coordinator's account, unchecked).
source: Consultant 21:06 CST Nov 13, from the owner's 21:04 chat question.
note: Triage 21:06 CST Nov 13: rule outcomes-judge-by-outcome. Fix: a hold a session sets (in a handoff, a message or a record) states its end event in the same line; a check refuses a hold line with no end. Red case first. Times are the consultant's, unchecked by triage. Existing hold steps to compare: lane-hold-end-trigger (closed page item) and drain-first-hold. Owner 21:04 CST Nov 13 (chat, verbatim via the consultant): "is this a bug on batch runner or correct? “The coordinator’s standing hold says I mark nothing ready and merge nothing until a go names the PR and its full head, and none names #3269 yet.”" It was a question, not a grant. Coordinator 21:08 CST Nov 13 (21:08; its own account, unchecked by triage), the incident: its 20:44 hold "stays held until the plan" did name an end, but it did not read the plan as done when the plan was filed at 20:56, and it lifted the hold at 21:05. The real gap: it did not check its own holds when the owner lifted the freeze at 20:41. Title and why rewritten in place to that gap. Lane session_013NEJL2P2bp8j5rFV59UQAv (Sonnet, medium): find the narrowest quiet form first, measure false alarms on real handoffs and messages, and stop and report if none; no guard that cries wolf.
